items.q: Bach music in fact, it seems to be classic music for a pianist to practice on, is because of the discipline of fingering.

ctx.x: That's rather confusing. But what I'm trying to say is Bach music in fact, it seems to be classic music for a pianist to practice on, is because of the discipline of fingering. Actually these notes are to be fingered by each finger separately. Each finger has a note that it plays. And church music is somewhat similar to that.
